rules.py.notes: Documented entries: 4 majors (full rule histories), Tour Finals, Olympics, Next Gen (short sets, supported=False). Everything else inferred per (tourney_code, season) from deciding-set score patterns: 3,807 tournament-year entries, 70 inferred as advantage. Inference independently recovers the documented advantage eras at RG/Wimbledon/AO. Empirical scan: 16 conflicts in 96,804 completed matches (0.017%), all Davis Cup ties (per-tie ids give almost no inference evidence); all flagged score_string_suspect. review_candidates() = 0 tournament-years above the 3%/30-match manual-review threshold, so the rules.py human checkpoint does not trigger. 15/15 tests pass incl. stage_0.notes: REDONE on TML-Database (vendor/). 100,658 matches 2010-01-03..2023-11-27, 39,596 ATP + 61,062 Challenger; 2024-2026 files never opened. Outcomes: completed 96,804 / retired 3,342 / walkover 502 / default 9 / unknown 1 (parsed from score-string RET/W-O/DEF markers - TML has no flag column). score_string_suspect 285 rows (0.28%). serve_stats_valid 92.2%. 105 tournament codes change surface. 62 rows had colliding ids (TML 'Rome'/'GA' field swap) - match_id now includes season. 24/24 tests pass. SCOPE DECISION (human, 2026-07-30): Davis Cup, Olympics, Tour Finals and Next Gen excluded via in_scope=False (4,041 rows); 96,617 in scope (35,555 ATP + 61,062 Challenger). Retirement policy confirmed as documented: retired excluded from rate/venue/correction fitting, included in Elo as win/loss; walkover and default update nothing.

stage_1.notes: engine.py closed form + simulate.py point-level MC. 55 gate tests pass: p_hold(0.5)==0.5 exactly, p_hold monotonic over p in (0.01,0.99), p_hold and p_tiebreak (7- and 10-point) match state-expansion enumeration to 1e-12 at 6 and 8 (pa,pb) points respectively; match distribution matches 70k-match point-level MC (>=1e7 points) within 4 SE on P(A), mean total games and P(any tiebreak) for all five format variants (advantage bo5, 12-12 TB bo5, 10-pt TB bo5, 7-pt TB bo5, 7-pt TB bo3) at two (pa,pb) pairs; symmetry p_match(a,b)+p_match(b,a)==1 and mirrored joint games distribution; advantage-set truncated mass ~1e-11 < TAIL_MASS_THRESHOLD 1e-9; ladder monotone; over+under+push==1; suspect-flagged matches excluded from validation targets. No hyperparameter fitted, so no ledger entry.

stage_2.notes: Selected on TUNE: half-life 730d, surface pooling 300 serve points, shrinkage n0 500 serve points (4x4x4 grid). GATE PASSED on both required comparisons: next-match serve-points-won MAE 0.06595 vs career-average 0.06834 and last-10 0.07004; match-winner log-loss through the Stage 1 engine 0.67106 vs 0.71706 and 0.74711. n=21,244 player-matches on TUNE. FIT-internal rolling-origin gain over career average: +0.00111/+0.00107/+0.00098/+0.00102/+0.00124 (mean +0.00108, std 0.00010); TUNE gain +0.00071 - BELOW the FIT gain, so no overfit signal. Opponent adjustment converged within 50 sweeps at 1e-6 with the level-period average serve-win% as the identifiability anchor. Ledger entry frozen. NOTE: serve_stats_valid now also excludes score_string_suspect rows (ground rule 8) - found by a test, fixed, dataset rebuilt (91,242 usable rows).

stage_3.notes: Surface Elo. Selected on TUNE (144-setting grid): K=48, Challenger K x0.75, surface blend 0.3, inactivity half-life 1095d, new-player level gap 100, cross-level offset 0. GATE PASSED: decile calibration max |gap| 0.0170 and mean |gap| 0.0085 against pre-set criteria 0.05/0.025; Brier 0.22483 vs rankings-baseline 0.22993 (log-loss 0.63977 vs 0.65107) on 11,225 TUNE matches. CROSS-LEVEL CHECK reported: Challenger-built vs tour-rated, n=2,883, predicted 0.4243 vs observed 0.4131, gap -0.0112 = 1.2 SE, within noise, so no level offset fitted. FIT rolling-origin gain mean +0.00833 std 0.00268, TUNE gain +0.01130, excess 0.00297 < envelope 0.00536 - no overfit signal. Ledger frozen.

stage_4.notes: Blend of serve gap and Elo gap; level taken from Stage 2, split blended. Elo win prob converted to a serve gap by inverting the Stage 1 engine on a 26x81 (level,gap) grid, round-tripped to 0.01 in tests. GATE PASSED: per-bucket w TUNE log-loss 0.63470 vs w=0 0.67107 and w=1 0.63655 on 10,622 TUNE matches. Selected w: overall 0.80; both-well-sampled 0.80, one-thin 0.85, both-thin 0.90 (thin threshold 1000 effective serve points) - thin data wants more Elo, as the spec expected. Disagreement metadata: mean abs 11.64pp, p90 24.50pp, 47.5% of matches above 10pp; carried out per match, not absorbed. FIT rolling-origin gain mean +0.00243 std 0.00097, TUNE gain +0.00185 - below FIT gain, no overfit signal.

stage_5.notes: Cohort kNN prior replaces the flat tour-average prior for thin players. Style vector: ace rate, DF rate, serve pw, return pw, clay lean, hand, height; features AND standardization stats both as-of the 91-day snapshot (test asserts truncating the future leaves earlier snapshots bit-identical). GATE PASSED on both required metrics, TUNE thin-data matches only (n=3,199): match-winner log-loss 0.63883 vs tour-average 0.63939; total-games CRPS 3.7113 vs 3.7191. Selected k=5. The opponent-vs-cohort adjustment is implemented and measured: it improves CRPS (3.7025) but costs log-loss (0.64043), and selection is on log-loss, so it ships OFF (opponent_vs_cohort_n0=0). Grid in the report shows the trade. FIT rolling-origin gain mean +0.00120 std 0.00038, TUNE gain +0.00056 - below FIT gain, no overfit signal.

stage_6.notes: Venue court-speed index, keyed (tourney_code, surface). FIRST ATTEMPT FAILED: multipliers estimated from raw serve-points-won made TUNE total-games CRPS at above-median-history venues WORSE at every setting (baseline 3.8418; best candidate 3.8499, worst 3.8587). Diagnosis: the raw average confounds court speed with field strength - a venue whose draw is full of big servers looks fast. FIX (one attempt, per the loop protocol): estimate the venue effect as a residual, observed serve points won over the model's own expected, so the field cancels. Residual multipliers are tighter than raw (std 0.0062 vs 0.0110, correlation 0.78). GATE PASSED on re-run: CRPS at above-median-history venues 3.8404 vs baseline 3.8418; unmeasured venues unchanged at 3.5880 (they get exactly the surface average, flagged measured=False). Selected shrink_n0=20,000 serve points, indoor flag not in the key (no measurable effect). Gain is small (+0.0014 CRPS); FIT rolling-origin gain mean +0.00149 std 0.00252, TUNE gain +0.00144 - no overfit signal.

stage_7.notes: GATE PASSED on the THIRD attempt. Attempts 1 and 2 are recorded below; the third exceeded the loop's two-attempt limit and was taken under the human's standing /goal directive to continue to completion, after the diagnosis pointed at a fix INSIDE Stage 7's mandate rather than outside it. ATTEMPT 1: one-sided inflation grid could not express the measured gap's sign; nothing moved. ATTEMPT 2: two-sided grid hit its edge at -0.06 and closed 37% of the gap. ATTEMPT 3 (the fix): the variance correction was wobbling the LEVEL. The spec says 'a variance-widening mix over (pa, pb)', and the lever that matters is the SPLIT: a real match's skill gap varies within the match, producing lopsided sets that iid points at a fixed split cannot. The mixture re-solves its centre split so it reproduces the uncorrected match-win probability - without that, wobbling drags every favourite toward even money and destroys the match-winner calibration Stages 3-4 earned. RESULT on TUNE (6,000 matches): tiebreak occurrence gap -0.0817 -> -0.0006 (criterion |gap| < 0.01); total-games PIT deviation 0.02873 -> 0.00697 and central-80% coverage 0.733 -> 0.807 (criterion 0.75-0.85); neither correction degraded the other. Selected: split_sigma 0.08, tiebreak_inflation -0.02 (a DEFLATION - the engine over-predicts tiebreaks on this data, the opposite of the spec's assumed direction), provenance scheme 'pooled'. All three provenance schemes were measured; documented-only has just 483 of 6,000 matches and worse calibration (-0.0229 residual gap). FIT rolling-origin gains: tiebreak +0.07704 +/-0.00925 vs TUNE +0.08117; PIT +0.01756 +/-0.00565 vs TUNE +0.02170. No overfit signal. Both ledger entries frozen. Engine change: match_distribution memoized (the mixture re-evaluates the same triples thousands of times).

stage_8.notes: SHIPPED BY HUMAN ACCEPTANCE, NOT A STRICT PASS. The gate as written required every eligible family to improve on BOTH ECE and Brier. On the replacement TEST window (2023-07-03..2023-11-27, 3,799 matches): totals_under_high improved on all three metrics (ECE 0.0349->0.0110, Brier 0.20895->0.20781, log-loss 0.60852->0.60591); match_winner improved ECE 0.0182->0.0169 but lost 0.0003 Brier (0.23981->0.24013), so the strict verdict is FAILED and reports/stage_validations/stage_8.md still says FAILED. The human reviewed the numbers and chose option A on 2026-07-30: accept, on the grounds that the isotonic map does what it exists for (calibration) and the Brier delta is a sharpness rounding on an already well-calibrated family. No model parameter changed; the saved maps are identical to those a strict pass would have saved. fitted_params.json records gate_strictly_passed=false and shipped_by_human_acceptance=true. Map ELIGIBILITY was decided on FIT+TUNE only, before TEST was opened. TEST touched once per window; the first window (2022-07-01..2023-06-30) is recorded burned in constants.py. The holdout cutoff never moved.

backtest.notes: HOLDOUT BACKTEST RUN ONCE, 2026-07-31, after explicit human go-ahead. Window 2024-01-01..2026-07-20, 24,572 matches loaded, 22,634 scoreable (completed, in scope, clean score, usable serve stats); retirements (863) and suspect scores (127) excluded from scoring and reported separately. BY FAMILY (Brier / ECE): set_betting 0.1711/0.0065, handicap 0.1676/0.0088, totals 0.1885/0.0081, tiebreak 0.2182/0.0091, match_winner 0.2255/0.0693. Match winner is by far the weakest calibration, exactly as MODEL_PROMPT.md predicted; the four distribution markets are all inside 1pp ECE. BY LEVEL: Challenger 0.1852 Brier on 352,946 selections, Masters 0.1745, ATP500 0.1701, Slam 0.1773. BY PROVENANCE: documented-rule matches 0.1773 Brier vs inferred 0.1827 - inferred calibrate slightly worse, the expected direction, which is why provenance was tracked. ABLATIONS (Brier / CRPS): full 0.1824/3.3800; no_cohort 0.1825/3.3809; no_venue 0.1824/3.3812; no_calibration 0.1824/3.3800 (ECE 0.0054 vs 0.0018); no_corrections 0.1929/3.5976. The Stage 7 corrections are the only component carrying real weight on unseen data; cohort and venue are worth ~0.0001 Brier each, matching the near-noise-floor gains flagged at the Stage 7 checkpoint. TWO BUGS FOUND AND FIXED DURING THE RUN, both in reporting/plumbing, neither in a fitted component: (1) match_winner and handicap were scored winner-first with a constant outcome, making ECE an artefact (0.4471 and 0.2494); both families are now scored in both orientations and the first report was discarded. Brier and log-loss were unaffected. (2) price.py could quote a total-games price below 1.0 because the isotonic map calibrates `under` alone and could push it above 1-push; the triple is now clamped so over+under+push==1. Backtest metrics are unaffected by (2) - it scores `under` directly and the maps are bounded in [0,1]. Three TML data defects in the 2024+ files also had to be handled: serve counters stored as text, seeds mixing text and numbers, and two Alicante Challengers sharing one tourney_id (555 colliding ids) plus 489 rows with no match_num. 190/190 tests pass.
